name: Calc Groups Cathedral
tagline: Build a cathedral of Calculation Groups on a real Fabric Semantic Model. 12 KPI variations, minimum base measures.

items.name: Cathedral_LH
items.purpose: Synthetic Sales / Date / Customer / Budget tables (3 years).

items.name: Cathedral_Model
items.purpose: Empty model with tables, relationships, ONE trivial seed measure. No calc groups (player builds them).

items.name: Cathedral_EH
items.purpose: Telemetry of submissions, pass/fail, elegance score.

items.name: CalcGroups_Seed
items.purpose: Run once: generate synthetic Sales/Budget data and load to Lakehouse.

validation_strategy.approach: Run 12 fixed DAX queries via XMLA against Cathedral_Model on locked test dates, compare to expected values (tolerance 0.01).
validation_strategy.elegance_score: 1 - (player_measure_count / 36); excludes the seed measure; calc items count as 0 (only the group counts).

implementability_notes.create_semantic_model: Fabric REST items POST with inline TMDL - proven by Racing game.
implementability_notes.execute_dax: MCP powerbi-model dax_query_operations - configured and tested.
implementability_notes.telemetry: Same pattern as Racing -> Eventhouse via REST ingestion.
